_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (Figure 2(g) and Section 3.3) on LibriTTS with Koel-TTS/NanoCodec. They are not on the scale of the runnable synthetic gym (different data, codec, metrics and model size) and are kept here as context only; they are not targets.

codec_stack2.description: Synthetic multi-codebook codec generation at the 2x frame-stacking operating point (at most 12 primary decoder steps per 24-frame utterance), the paper's recommended speed/quality balance. Proposed row `generator_2x`; comparison rows are frozen by the hidden evaluator (independent parallel heads at 1x and 2x, MaskGIT local transformer at 2x). Values in `results` are from this gym's reference run on the hidden test, not paper numbers.

codec_fd.description: The paper's Frechet distance in the codec's embedding space: full-covariance FD between generated and reference consecutive-frame pairs of the public 24-d FSQ codec latent (48 dimensions per pair); no clipping. A failed run receives the distance of uniform random tokens.

codebook_pair_divergence.description: Implausible codebook combinations, measured without a moment assumption: mean Jensen-Shannon divergence (bits) between generated and reference joint token distributions over the 28 within-frame codebook pairs and the 64 (frame t, frame t+1) codebook pairs. A failed run receives the divergence of uniform random tokens.

speaker_conditioned_codec_fd.description: Speaker-similarity analogue: the codec FD computed separately for each of the 16 conditioning speakers and averaged; no clipping. A failed run receives the distance of uniform random tokens.

codec_stack4.description: Synthetic multi-codebook codec generation at the aggressive 4x frame-stacking operating point (at most 6 primary decoder steps per 24-frame utterance), where the paper reports its own method losing quality. Proposed row `generator_4x`; comparison rows are frozen by the hidden evaluator (parallel heads at 4x, MaskGIT local transformer at 4x). Values in `results` are from this gym's reference run on the hidden test, not paper numbers.

speaker_conditioned_codec_fd.description: Speaker-similarity analogue: the codec FD computed separately for each of the 16 conditioning speakers and averaged; no clipping. A failed run receives the distance of uniform random tokens.

codec_fewshot_stack4.description: Few-shot speakers at the aggressive 4x frame-stacking operating point (at most 6 primary decoder steps per 24-frame utterance): an independent hidden open-speaker process in which 192 speakers have 160 training utterances each and the 64 evaluation speakers only 8 each (`data/synthetic_codec_fewshot`). This is the scaled counterpart of the paper's reported shortfall, the loss of speaker robustness at 4x for speakers the training data cover poorly (unseen speakers, Figure 2(d)); the train and test slices use disjoint halves of the 64 speakers. Proposed row `generator_fewshot_4x`; comparison rows are frozen by the hidden evaluator (parallel heads and MaskGIT local transformer at 4x on the same data). Values in `results` are from this gym's reference run on the hidden test, not paper numbers.

codec_fd.description: The paper's Frechet distance in the codec's embedding space: full-covariance FD between generated and reference consecutive-frame pairs of the public 24-d FSQ codec latent (48 dimensions per pair); no clipping. A failed run receives the distance of uniform random tokens.

speaker_conditioned_codec_fd.description: Speaker-similarity analogue: the codec FD computed separately for each of the 32 few-shot evaluation speakers of the slice and averaged; no clipping. A failed run receives the distance of uniform random tokens.

_ranking: Feasibility first. Within each tier: sum experiment weight times absolute metric coefficient times improvement in higher_is_better direction over the frozen raw-output reference, divided by population standard deviation across the currently ranked attempts plus reference (zero variance contributes zero).
